en: LOSATN and TLOSATX E-values use one scale for each pair of genomes: a genome is the files whose records share a row, with every record of those files counted, drawn or not, so a crop, a window or a split into files does not change them. LOSATP E-values use the proteins of the subject genome as the database size, every protein of every record of its files, drawn or not, so a crop, a window or a split into files does not change them either. For a genome pair whose drawn records are each the whole of a one-record file, LOSAT keeps its own scale, which it adjusts for the length of a hit, so that pair's E-values differ slightly from those of the same genomes cropped. A genome pair whose search space is past the largest LOSAT reads is searched per file, with a warning.
